_how: What the chat reads in a person's own words in this language: one meaning to a list of what a person types for it. A plain entry is a phrase, matched whatever its case or width, as a whole word where its language spaces its words; {what}, {lang}, {n} and the like mark a place the person fills; an entry after re: is a Java regular expression. Every language's file is read, so a person is understood in their own language whatever language the pages are in. A word under yes.alone is a yes only as the whole answer or before a comma or a stop, because it can also open an ordinary sentence (a single letter, si, claro, да); a word under yes may be followed by more words.
